test_refs.case: production Codex host keeps containment inside the worker sandbox boundary

clauses.statement: The worker registers the codex child pid in codex-process.json synchronously (writeFileSync) immediately after spawn and before any await, and terminateWorkerTree re-resolves codex-process.json whenever codexPid is unknown — before escalation phases and before the final containment confirmation, SIGKILLing a late-resolved pid — so an unregistered detached codex child is never reported as contained.
clauses.rationale: AC5: an inspection-found (not flake-observed) hardening — the async registration window plus waitForPidExit(null)=true semantics could in principle let shutdown report success without ever signaling a detached codex child whose pid registration was starved past the escalation ladder.

story_refs.text_snippet: AC5: worker は codex 子プロセスの spawn 直後に同期的（writeFileSync）に codex-process.json を登録し、host の terminateWorkerTree は codexPid 不明のとき escalation 各段階と最終確認前に codex-process.json を再解決

test_refs.case: production Codex host shutdown contains the detached worker process group

clauses.statement: Test fixtures write pid files and signal markers atomically (tmp+rename), and the test-side waits parse the pid file content until it is a positive integer (> 1) instead of checking file existence alone, so a zero-byte read can never yield childPid=0 — whose isProcessAlive(0) via process.kill(0,0) is always true and made the post-shutdown wait structurally unsatisfiable at any deadline.
clauses.rationale: AC6: the measured root cause of the surviving 300s timeouts (18-run instrumented harness, 2 leaks, both rawChildPidContent empty) was the fixture's non-atomic pid write racing the access()-only poll; production containment signal delivery was confirmed correct in every run.

story_refs.text_snippet: AC6: テストフィクスチャの pid ファイル・シグナルマーカーの書き込みは tmp+rename でアトミック化し、テスト側の読み取りは「非空・正整数としてパースできるまで」を待機条件に含める。
